P01958.name: Hemoglobin subunit alpha
P01958.function: Involved in oxygen transport from the lung to the various peripheral tissues. Hemopressin acts as an antagonist peptide of the cannabinoid receptor CNR1. Hemopressin-binding efficiently blocks cannabinoid receptor CNR1 and subsequent signaling.
P01958.subunit: Heterotetramer of two alpha chains and two beta chains
